sentences.en: They take this negative way of protesting against adult domination.
sentences.zh: 他们用这种方式消极地抗议成年人的统治。

sentences.en: Stress can have an enormous negative impact on your health.
sentences.zh: 压力会对你的健康产生巨大的负面影响。

sentences.en: Life is like photography; you used the negatives to develop.
sentences.zh: 人生就像摄影；你用底片来冲洗照片。

senses.zh: [数] 负的；消极的；否定的；阴性的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：neg（否定）+ative（…的）→否定的
